name: Four Points by Sheraton Bangkok, Sukhumvit 15
short_description: A select-service Four Points on Sukhumvit Soi 15, a five-minute walk from Terminal 21 and BTS Asoke, with a rooftop pool bar and craft-beer bar.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Bangkok, Sukhumvit 15 is a select-service hotel tucked just off Sukhumvit Road at Soi 15, a five-minute walk from the Terminal 21 shopping mall and BTS Asoke/MRT Sukhumvit stations. Guest reviews describe rooms as modern and well-kept, with fresh furnishings and reliable air conditioning, and the property's social spaces -- a rooftop pool bar and a more casual craft-beer bar -- draw specific praise as popular with both guests and local regulars. Staff service is consistently called excellent and welcoming. Reviewers generally find the pricing reasonable for the central Asoke-area location, especially relative to the city's full-service Bonvoy hotels nearby. The main watchouts are cosmetic rather than structural: most rooms face neighboring buildings rather than open views, Sukhumvit traffic outside can be heavy at peak hours, and a handful of guests note the hotel runs a bit pricier than expected for the select-service tier. It's a solid fit for travelers who want a central, walkable Sukhumvit base with a livelier rooftop social scene, without paying full-service Bonvoy rates.

faqs.question: How close is Four Points Bangkok Sukhumvit 15 to Terminal 21?
faqs.answer: It's about a five-minute walk to the Terminal 21 shopping mall, which also connects directly to BTS Asoke and MRT Sukhumvit stations, making this one of the more walkable select-service Bonvoy hotels in the Sukhumvit corridor.

faqs.question: Does this Four Points have good views?
faqs.answer: Not typically -- guest reviews note that most rooms face neighboring buildings rather than open skyline views, so travelers prioritizing a view may want to check room categories carefully or consider a different property.

reviews.author: JapanAtoZee
reviews.summary: Two-night stay near BTS Asok. Praises the very comfortable bed, quiet rooms and a solid breakfast buffet with Thai options; dings unreliable Wi-Fi and a slow key-card fix but would return.

reviews.title: Four Points by Sheraton Bangkok, Sukhumvit 15 Review
reviews.author: AB
reviews.summary: Favorable Marriott Bonvoy-focused review: spacious rooms with city views, rooftop pool and bar, all-day dining. Advises taking the free breakfast-for-two benefit; no on-site lounge but easy BTS/MRT access.

reviews.title: Four Points by Sheraton Bangkok, Sukhumvit 15
reviews.summary: Balanced blog review calling out the fantastic location and spacious rooms plus multiple bars (amBar, BeerVault), while noting inconsistent service, some bathroom wear and paid Wi-Fi. Rated good value.
